findings.description: evaluate() sets playbackSource unconditionally (line 184) before confirming evaluate() succeeds. If evaluate() throws, playbackSource still claims the source beat is playing, contradicting the intended contract that a failed evaluation does not claim the beat is audible.
sessionName and openBeat parameters are accepted but never read; the loop writes all dirty drafts across all sessions without filtering by session or checking conflicts/saved state.
saveAllSessions writes sessionDrafts.drafts[beat] without checking sessionDrafts.conflicts or comparing against saved content, so it may overwrite conflicts or unmodified drafts as new saves.
closeBehavior casts r.closeBehavior directly to the union without validating it belongs to 'ask' | 'auto-save' | 'discard'; corrupt strings pass through silently.
Tests are stubs (expect(true).toBe(true)) and do not exercise playback source state transitions.

closeCoordinator introduces a second cross-session save surface that duplicates desktop.beats.write logic but ignores conflicts/saved state. Not required by stated intent; recommend removing unless multi-session save-all is an explicit required feature.

testing_summary: Inspected diff and source files manually; did not execute tests (per review-phase rules). Confirmed playbackSource set occurs before success confirmation, closeCoordinator ignores conflicts/unused params, settings closeBehavior lacks validation.
risk_rationale: Playback source tracking can falsely claim success on failure; closeCoordinator introduces parallel save logic without conflict/saved-state guards; settings allow corrupt closeBehavior; no authorization/privacy boundary issues found.
